prompt:
Using the uploaded SBML model, simulate from time 0 through 10 seconds with exactly 20 equal output intervals (21 output points including both endpoints). Keep all initial values and parameters unchanged. Retain the numerical time-course data for P. Do not fetch another model or use external sources. No plot or secondary question analysis is requested.
Integration API clarification: this is a locally uploaded model. Omit the optional biomodel_id field entirely; do not pass null or invent an ID. Use use_uploaded_sbml_file=true. In this implementation time_data.interval is the NUMBER of output intervals, not the time step. Use duration=10.0 and interval=20. Only a simulate_model tool call is needed.
